cover.title: An Evening with Audra McDonald
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: Audra McDonald is the finest stage actress of her generation. She is nothing short of magnificent. The Wall Street Journal

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Winner of a record-breaking six Tony Awards, two Grammy Awards, an Emmy, and recipient of the National Medal of Arts, Audra McDonald returns to Boston for an extraordinary concert— performing her signature mix of songs from Broadway, the Great American Songbook, and beyond.
body: Join us for an intimate evening of music with Broadway star Audra McDonald—winner of a record-breaking six Tony Awards, two Grammy Awards, an Emmy, and recipient of the National Medal of Arts—as she returns to Boston for an extraordinary concert with her band. She'll perform her signature mix of songs from Broadway, the Great American Songbook, and beyond, captivating audiences with her unmistakable warmth and artistry, and her unparalleled gift for storytelling.
